title: AI Fairness: from Principles to Practice
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to religion. Religion is mentioned only as a legally protected characteristic in the context of non-discrimination laws and as an example of an attribute for which data may be hard to collect.
findings: The paper does not contain any specific findings related to religion. It mentions 'religion' and 'religious beliefs' as examples of protected characteristics under non-discrimination laws, for which data may be difficult to obtain for fairness testing.
